text:
- **Codex session replies:** An idle Codex session now wakes when the owner replies. The pm service queues each reply into a live Codex session, and a live test confirmed the wake-up.
- **Public website access:** The public site now requires a valid Cloudflare Access token and refuses requests without one. Install commands point to the latest release, and the README and website credit Beads and Dolt.
- **Pull request checks:** Checks now finish much faster, and the macOS and race jobs run faster too. The Go tests run in parallel, and the build cache stays warm.
- **Design page coverage:** Design pages now name the code they cover. Work is in progress to require a design page update when covered code changes.
